g.text: System design — failure modes, cost and when to graduate
ACCEPTED DESIGN · ADR-0006 · built = part of the S10 deployment; documented = explained, with mitigations listed, not built. Costs are projections.
US profile, then breaker → Foundry, same models
lease expiry → next attempt; fenced commit
collect the rest; no fabricated memo
multi-AZ RF 2 (scale tier); rebuild from Parquet
Cloudflare status page; nothing else runs
COST SHARE BY TIER (projection, per month)
below ~1K users fixed infrastructure dominates; above it, tokens and identity do.
* rerank only if Gate C adopts it · DeepSeek V3.2 + gpt-oss ≈ $0.014 / uncached memo
GRADUATION TRIGGERS · change the component only when its trigger is measured
stated SLO ≥ 99.95% or a paying user
10M tier with a measured business case
frozen evidence, paired tolerance vs the active approved baseline
budget: AWS Budgets 100% of $100 → SSM flag → API 503 for new jobs
Gate A on frozen evidence; S2-T00b, S2-T00d done
S7 seams: Postgres RunStore + queue, caches,
Bedrock model qualification; Gate C if embeddings change
before the environment is left running
Foundry + embedding parity (fallbacks off until pass)
two clean apply → smoke → destroy rehearsals
